title: CPI lights up 17 pts ES 1m release bars

hero.caption: That's the average 1-minute release candle range on CPI prints for ES. **Max 110 pts** in 2022.

chart.label: Release-bar range, year by year
chart.note: 2022 was the clear peak with avg over 50 pts, earlier years tiny.

useIt: I check the CPI 1m range before 8:30 to set risk. Expect ~17 pts avg on ES, but can explode to 110 pts like 2022 — size accordingly and wait for the bar to print before fading or pressing. The number sets the initial volatility scale.
disclaimer: Not advice · AI-backtested on 10y ES · check it yourself
